THE WHOLE JOURNEY MATTERS

An ad is an introduction.
What happens next matters too.

Pay-per-click advertising means paying when someone clicks your ad. The work around that click includes understanding the search, shaping the message and creating a relevant destination.

Our PPC approach connects campaign planning with web design, tracking and ongoing review. So the conversation doesn't stop when an ad goes live.

01 / ONBOARDING & CAMPAIGN PLANNING

First, get
on the same page.

We begin with a conversation about your business and the information needed to plan your campaigns.

Keyword research, ad copy, landing pages and tracking come together in that plan. You review and approve the campaign before launch.

✓

Your approval comes first.
The plan is yours to review before it goes live.

02 / CAMPAIGN LAUNCH

Ready.
Reviewed.
Live.
CAMPAIGN PATH
Plan
→

→
Launch

Message + destination + tracking

Once you've approved the campaign, we launch it and begin monitoring how it relates to your business, customers and goals.

Campaign communication continues after launch, with reviews and updates as the work develops.

Not just an ad.
A connected setup.

Six capabilities that support the campaign, from the account to the ongoing adjustments.
